build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
build_task_function: build a physics scene with a slope, container, ball, and lid using build_task
add_convex_polygon: add a convex polygon slope to the PHYRE scene using C.add_convex_polygon

add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the PHYRE scene using C.add with position and radius
